      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor ad df)) g (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair b d x)

    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction c)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor ce ef)) g (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair e f y)

    { smul := fun q z => (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act X q z.1, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act Y q z.2)
      one_smul := fun z => Prod.ext (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.one_act X z.1)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.one_act Y z.2)

      (r : LowerLabel P i j) (w : Fiber P i j) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis b d i j r w

      (i : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding P A) (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding P F)
      (r : LowerLabel P i j) =>

  (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (A i)) →
  (∀ j, Finset.Nonempty (B j)) →
  Pairwise (fun i i' => Disjoint (A i) (A i')) →
  Pairwise (fun j j' => Disjoint (B j) (B j')) →
  (∀ x : ↥X, ∃ i, x ∈ A i) →
  (∀ x : ↥X, ∃ j, x ∈ B j) →
  let G := Equiv.Perm ↥X
  let blockSym := fun S : Finset ↥X =>
    MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : ↥X => x ∈ S))

  let H : Subgroup G := iSup (fun j => blockSym (B j))
  ∀ σ : G,
    K ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj σ)) H =
      iSup (fun i => iSup (fun j =>
        blockSym (A i ∩ Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding σ) (B j))))

∀ (n n1 n2 : Nat), 1 ≤ n1 → n1 < n → 1 ≤ n2 → n2 < n →
  let X : Finset Nat := Finset.Icc 1 n
  let G := Equiv.Perm ↥X
  let interval := fun lo hi : Nat =>
    Finset.filter (fun x : ↥X => lo ≤ x.val ∧ x.val ≤ hi) Finset.univ
  let XBlock : Fin 2 → Finset ↥X := fun r =>
    if r = 0 then interval 1 n1 else interval (n1 + 1) n
  let YBlock : Fin 2 → Finset ↥X := fun c =>
    if c = 0 then interval 1 n2 else interval (n2 + 1) n
  let blockSym := fun S : Finset ↥X =>
    MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : ↥X => x ∈ S))
  let K : Subgroup G := iSup (fun r => blockSym (XBlock r))
  let H : Subgroup G := iSup (fun c => blockSym (YBlock c))
  let s := Nat.min n1 n2
  let t := Nat.max n1 n2
  let m := Nat.min s (n - t)
  let a : Fin (m + 1) → Int := fun i => Int.ofNat s - Int.ofNat i.val
  ∃ (left right : Fin m → ↥X) (σ : Fin (m + 1) → G),
    (∀ j : Fin m, (left j).val = s - j.val ∧ (right j).val = t + j.val + 1) ∧
    let τ : Fin m → G := fun j => Equiv.swap (left j) (right j)
    σ 0 = 1 ∧
    (∀ j : Fin m, σ (Fin.succ j) = τ j * σ (Fin.castSucc j)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun j k => Disjoint (Equiv.Perm.support (τ j)) (Equiv.Perm.support (τ k))) ∧
    Function.Bijective (fun i => DoubleCoset.mk K H (σ i)) ∧
    Set.BijOn a Set.univ
      (Set.Icc (max 0 (Int.ofNat n1 + Int.ofNat n2 - Int.ofNat n)) (Int.ofNat s)) ∧
    ∀ i : Fin (m + 1),
      let C : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Finset ↥X := fun r c =>
        XBlock r ∩ Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding (σ i)) (YBlock c)
      let size := fun r c => Int.ofNat (Finset.card (C r c))
      size 0 0 = a i ∧
      size 0 1 = Int.ofNat n1 - a i ∧
      size 1 0 = Int.ofNat n2 - a i ∧
      size 1 1 = Int.ofNat n - Int.ofNat n1 - Int.ofNat n2 + a i ∧
      (∀ r c, ∃ lo hi : Nat, C r c = interval lo hi) ∧
      K ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (σ i))) H =
        iSup (fun p : {p : Fin 2 × Fin 2 // Finset.Nonempty (C p.1 p.2)} =>
          blockSym (C p.val.1 p.val.2))

∀ (X : Finset Nat) (g r c : Nat)
    (D : Fin g → Finset Nat) (A : Fin r → Finset Nat) (B : Fin c → Finset Nat),
  (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (D i)) →
  (∀ a, Finset.Nonempty (A a)) →
  (∀ b, Finset.Nonempty (B b)) →
  Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j)) →
  Pairwise (fun a a' => Disjoint (A a) (A a')) →
  Pairwise (fun b b' => Disjoint (B b) (B b')) →
  (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, n ∈ D i) →
  (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ a, n ∈ A a) →
  (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ b, n ∈ B b) →
  let blockSym := fun S : Finset Nat =>
    MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ S))
  let G : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) := iSup (fun i => blockSym (D i))
  let K₀ : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) := iSup (fun a => blockSym (A a))
  let H₀ : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) := iSup (fun b => blockSym (B b))
  K₀ ≤ G → H₀ ≤ G →
  let K := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) K₀
  let H := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) H₀
  let Gᵢ := fun i : Fin g => Equiv.Perm ↥(D i)
  let rows := fun i : Fin g =>
    Finset.filter (fun a : Fin r => A a ⊆ D i) Finset.univ
  let cols := fun i : Fin g =>
    Finset.filter (fun b : Fin c => B b ⊆ D i) Finset.univ
  let row := fun (i : Fin g) (a : Fin (Finset.card (rows i))) =>
    Finset.subtype (fun n : Nat => n ∈ D i)
      (A ((Finset.orderIsoOfFin (rows i) rfl a).val))
  let col := fun (i : Fin g) (b : Fin (Finset.card (cols i))) =>
    Finset.subtype (fun n : Nat => n ∈ D i)
      (B ((Finset.orderIsoOfFin (cols i) rfl b).val))
  let localSym := fun (i : Fin g) (S : Finset ↥(D i)) =>
    MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : ↥(D i) => n ∈ S))
  let Kᵢ := fun i : Fin g => iSup (fun a => localSym i (row i a))
  let Hᵢ := fun i : Fin g => iSup (fun b => localSym i (col i b))
  let Mat := fun i : Fin g =>
    {R : Fin (Finset.card (rows i)) → Fin (Finset.card (cols i)) → Nat //
      (∀ a, Finset.sum Finset.univ (R a) = Finset.card (row i a)) ∧
      (∀ b, Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun a => R a b) = Finset.card (col i b))}
  let rank := fun (i : Fin g) (S : Finset ↥(D i)) (x : ↥S) =>
    ((Finset.orderIsoOfFin S rfl).symm x).val
  let Q := DoubleCoset.Quotient (K : Set G) (H : Set G)
  let Qᵢ := fun i : Fin g => DoubleCoset.Quotient (Kᵢ i : Set (Gᵢ i)) (Hᵢ i : Set (Gᵢ i))
  let extend := fun (i : Fin g) (σ : Gᵢ i) =>
    Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ D i) σ
  (∀ a, ∃ i, A a ⊆ D i) ∧
  (∀ b, ∃ i, B b ⊆ D i) ∧
  ∃ (split : G ≃* (∀ i, Gᵢ i)) (quotientSplit : Q ≃ (∀ i, Qᵢ i))
    (classify : ∀ i, Qᵢ i ≃ Mat i) (localRep : ∀ i, Mat i → Gᵢ i)
    (rep : (∀ i, Mat i) → G),
    (∀ (σ : G) (i : Fin g) (x : ↥(D i)),
      (split σ i x).val = (σ : Equiv.Perm Nat) x.val) ∧
    (∀ σ : G, (σ ∈ K ↔ ∀ i, split σ i ∈ Kᵢ i) ∧
      (σ ∈ H ↔ ∀ i, split σ i ∈ Hᵢ i)) ∧
    (∀ (σ : G) i,
      quotientSplit (DoubleCoset.mk K H σ) i = DoubleCoset.mk (Kᵢ i) (Hᵢ i) (split σ i)) ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin g) (σ : Gᵢ i) a b,
      (classify i (DoubleCoset.mk (Kᵢ i) (Hᵢ i) σ)).val a b =
        Finset.card (row i a ∩ Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding σ) (col i b))) ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin g) (R : Mat i),
      DoubleCoset.mk (Kᵢ i) (Hᵢ i) (localRep i R) = (classify i).symm R) ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin g) (R : Mat i), Kᵢ i ≠ ⊤ → Hᵢ i ≠ ⊤ →
      ∀ a b (x : ↥(row i a)) (y : ↥(col i b)),
        localRep i R y.val = x.val ↔
          ∃ k : Fin (R.val a b),
            rank i (row i a) x = Finset.sum (Finset.Iio b) (fun b' => R.val a b') + k.val ∧
            rank i (col i b) y = Finset.sum (Finset.Iio a) (fun a' => R.val a' b) + k.val) ∧
    (∀ i, (Kᵢ i = ⊤ ∨ Hᵢ i = ⊤) → ∀ R : Mat i, localRep i R = 1) ∧
    (∀ R : ∀ i, Mat i,
      Pairwise (fun i j =>
        Disjoint {n : Nat | extend i (localRep i (R i)) n ≠ n}
          {n : Nat | extend j (localRep j (R j)) n ≠ n})) ∧
    (∀ R : ∀ i, Mat i,
      (rep R : Equiv.Perm Nat) = List.prod (List.ofFn (fun i => extend i (localRep i (R i))))) ∧
    Function.Bijective (fun R => DoubleCoset.mk K H (rep R))

let P := Equiv.Perm Nat
let Finitary := Subgroup.closure {s : P | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap s}
let conj := fun (s : P) => MulAut.conj s
let conjugate := fun (s : P) (S : Subgroup P) =>
  Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (conj s)) S
let blockSym := fun (S : Finset Nat) =>
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ S))
let forward := fun {S T : Subgroup P} (p : P) (hp : conjugate p S ≤ T) =>
  MonoidHom.comp (Subgroup.inclusion hp)
    (MonoidHom.subgroupMap (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (conj p)) S)
let backward := fun {S T : Subgroup P} (p : P) (hp : T ≤ conjugate p S) =>
  MonoidHom.comp (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulEquiv.subgroupMap (conj p) S).symm)
    (Subgroup.inclusion hp)
let Mod := fun S : Subgroup P => ModuleCat.{v} (MonoidAlgebra Complex S)
let Res := fun {S T : Subgroup P} (f : S →* T) =>
  (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex f).toRingHom :
    CategoryTheory.Functor (Mod T) (Mod S))
let Ind := fun {S T : Subgroup P} (f : S →* T) =>
  (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
    (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
      (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := S))
      (Rep.indFunctor Complex f))
    (Rep.toModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := T)) :
    CategoryTheory.Functor (Mod S) (Mod T))
∀ (K H G : Subgroup P) (α β : ↥Finitary)
  (X : Finset Nat) (g r c : Nat)
  (D : Fin g → Finset Nat) (A : Fin r → Finset Nat) (B : Fin c → Finset Nat),
  (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (D i)) →
  (∀ a, Finset.Nonempty (A a)) →
  (∀ b, Finset.Nonempty (B b)) →
  Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j)) →
  Pairwise (fun a a' => Disjoint (A a) (A a')) →
  Pairwise (fun b b' => Disjoint (B b) (B b')) →
  (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, n ∈ D i) →
  (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ a, n ∈ A a) →
  (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ b, n ∈ B b) →
  let Kα := conjugate (α : P) K
  let Hβ := conjugate (β : P) H
  G = iSup (fun i => blockSym (D i)) →
  Kα = iSup (fun a => blockSym (A a)) →
  Hβ = iSup (fun b => blockSym (B b)) →
  ∀ (hK : Kα ≤ G) (hH : Hβ ≤ G),
    let left := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Kα
    let right := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Hβ
    let Q := DoubleCoset.Quotient (left : Set G) (right : Set G)
    let rows := fun i : Fin g =>
      Finset.filter (fun a : Fin r => A a ⊆ D i) Finset.univ
    let cols := fun i : Fin g =>
      Finset.filter (fun b : Fin c => B b ⊆ D i) Finset.univ
    let row := fun (i : Fin g) (a : Fin (Finset.card (rows i))) =>
      Finset.subtype (fun n : Nat => n ∈ D i)
        (A ((Finset.orderIsoOfFin (rows i) rfl a).val))
    let col := fun (i : Fin g) (b : Fin (Finset.card (cols i))) =>
      Finset.subtype (fun n : Nat => n ∈ D i)
        (B ((Finset.orderIsoOfFin (cols i) rfl b).val))
    let Mat := fun i : Fin g =>
      {R : Fin (Finset.card (rows i)) → Fin (Finset.card (cols i)) → Nat //
        (∀ a, Finset.sum Finset.univ (R a) = Finset.card (row i a)) ∧
        (∀ b, Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun a => R a b) = Finset.card (col i b))}
    let J := ∀ i : Fin g, Mat i
    let rank := fun (i : Fin g) (S : Finset ↥(D i)) (x : ↥S) =>
      ((Finset.orderIsoOfFin S rfl).symm x).val
    let αmap : K →* G := forward (α : P) hK
    let βmap : H →* G := forward (β : P) hH
    ∃ (split : G ≃* (∀ i : Fin g, Equiv.Perm ↥(D i))) (classify : Q ≃ J) (σ : J → G),
      (∀ (s : G) (i : Fin g) (x : ↥(D i)), (split s i x).val = (s : P) x.val) ∧
      (∀ (s : G) (i : Fin g) a b,
        (classify (DoubleCoset.mk left right s) i).val a b =
          Finset.card (row i a ∩ Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding (split s i)) (col i b))) ∧
      (∀ R : J, DoubleCoset.mk left right (σ R) = classify.symm R) ∧
      (∀ (R : J) (i : Fin g) a b (x : ↥(row i a)) (y : ↥(col i b)),
        split (σ R) i y.val = x.val ↔
          ∃ k : Fin ((R i).val a b),
            rank i (row i a) x =
              Finset.sum (Finset.Iio b) (fun b' => (R i).val a b') + k.val ∧
            rank i (col i b) y =
              Finset.sum (Finset.Iio a) (fun a' => (R i).val a' b) + k.val) ∧
      let L := fun R : J => Kα ⊓ conjugate ((σ R : P) * (β : P)) H
      let lambdaMap : ∀ R : J, L R →* K := fun R =>
        backward (α : P) (show L R ≤ Kα from inf_le_left)
      let muMap : ∀ R : J, L R →* H := fun R =>
        backward ((σ R : P) * (β : P))
          (show L R ≤ conjugate ((σ R : P) * (β : P)) H from inf_le_right)
      (∀ R : J,
        L R = iSup (fun a => iSup (fun b =>
          blockSym (A a ∩ Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding (σ R : P)) (B b))))) ∧
      Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Iso
        (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (Ind βmap) (Res αmap))
        (CategoryTheory.Limits.sigmaObj
          (fun R : J => CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (Res (muMap R)) (Ind (lambdaMap R))))) ∧
      ((∀ k : K, (αmap k : P) = (k : P)) →
        (∀ h : H, (βmap h : P) = (h : P)) →
        let T := fun R : J => conjugate (σ R : P)⁻¹ (L R)
        let transport : ∀ R : J, L R →* T R := fun R =>
          MonoidHom.subgroupMap
            (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (conj (σ R : P)⁻¹)) (L R)
        ∃ (hKG : K ≤ G) (hHG : H ≤ G) (hLK : ∀ R : J, L R ≤ K) (hTH : ∀ R : J, T R ≤ H),
          Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Iso
            (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
              (Ind (Subgroup.inclusion hHG)) (Res (Subgroup.inclusion hKG)))
            (CategoryTheory.Limits.sigmaObj (fun R : J =>
              CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
                (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
                  (Res (Subgroup.inclusion (hTH R))) (Res (transport R)))
                (Ind (Subgroup.inclusion (hLK R)))))))

let U := ↥(Subgroup.closure {g : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap g})
let blockSym : Finset Nat → Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
  fun X => MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : Nat => x ∈ X))
let parabolic : Subgroup U → Prop := fun S =>
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (blocks i)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
    Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype _) S = iSup (fun i => blockSym (blocks i))
∀ (K H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U),
  parabolic K → parabolic H → parabolic G →
  let conjugate := fun (c : U) (S : Subgroup U) =>
    Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj c)) S
  ∀ (hα : conjugate α K ≤ G) (hβ : conjugate β H ≤ G),
    let a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K G :=
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α
        (fun k => hα ⟨(k : U), k.property, rfl⟩)
    let b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G :=
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β
        (fun h => hβ ⟨(h : U), h.property, rfl⟩)
    let A := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a)
    let B := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b)
    let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
      let Lj := fun j : J => conjugate α K ⊓ conjugate ((σ j : U) * β) H
      let left := fun (j : J) (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj j) =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := S) (G := K) α⁻¹ (by
          intro ℓ
          obtain ⟨k, hk, heq⟩ := (hS ℓ.property).1
          change α * k * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
          rw [← heq]
          change k ∈ K at hk
          convert hk using 1
          group)
      let right := fun (j : J) (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj j) =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := S) (G := H)
          (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹) (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨h, hh, heq⟩ := (hS ℓ.property).2
            change (σ j : U) * β * h * ((σ j : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
            rw [← heq]
            change h ∈ H at hh
            convert hh using 1
            group)
      let dot := fun (j : J) (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj j) =>
        show MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a (left j S hS))
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b (right j S hS)) from
          ⟨σ j, by
            intro ℓ
            apply Subtype.ext
            change α * (α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹) * α⁻¹ * (σ j : U) =
              (σ j : U) * (β * ((β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) *
                (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹)⁻¹) * β⁻¹)
            group⟩
      let M := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b)
      let finiteFibers := fun (j : J) (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj j) =>
        ∀ z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier,
          Set.Finite {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b
            (left j S hS) (right j S hS) (dot j S hS) w = z}
      let outer := fun (j : J) (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj j)
          (hf : finiteFibers j S hS) =>
        show MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M M from
          MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection a b (left j S hS) (right j S hS)
              [(1, ⟨dot j S hS, hf⟩)])
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication a b (left j S hS) (right j S hS)
              [(1, dot j S hS)])
      ∀ (J₀ : Set J),
        let I := {j : J // j ∈ J₀}
        ∀ (j₀ : I),
          let C := G ⊓ Subgroup.centralizer
            (Set.range (fun j : I => (σ j₀.val : U) * (σ j.val : U)⁻¹))
          let P := (iInf (fun j : I => Lj j.val)) ⊓ C
          let L := Subgroup.closure {g : U | g ∈ P ∧ Equiv.Perm.IsSwap (Subtype.val g)}
          let hL : ∀ j : I, L ≤ Lj j.val := fun j =>
            le_trans ((Subgroup.closure_le P).mpr (fun _ hg => hg.1))
              (le_trans inf_le_left (iInf_le (fun i : I => Lj i.val) j))
          let admissible := fun S : Subgroup U =>
            parabolic S ∧
              ∃ hS : ∀ j : I, S ≤ Lj j.val,
                ∀ i j : I,
                  left i.val S (hS i) = left j.val S (hS j) ∧
                  right i.val S (hS i) = right j.val S (hS j)
          IsGreatest {S : Subgroup U | admissible S} L ∧
          (∀ S : Subgroup U, admissible S → ∀ j : I,
            Subgroup.relIndex L (Lj j.val) ≤ Subgroup.relIndex S (Lj j.val)) ∧
          (∃ (finite : Fintype I)
              (hfL : ∀ j : I, finiteFibers j.val L (hL j))
              (hfJ : ∀ j : I, finiteFibers j.val (Lj j.val) (le_refl (Lj j.val))),
            let indices : Finset I := @Finset.univ I finite
            let restricted := fun j : I => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale
              ((Subgroup.relIndex L (Lj j.val) : Complex)⁻¹) (outer j.val L (hL j) (hfL j))
            let usual := fun j : I => outer j.val (Lj j.val) (le_refl (Lj j.val)) (hfJ j)
            let restrictedSum : MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing Complex M M I :=
              MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.mk indices restricted
            let usualSum : MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing Complex M M I :=
              MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.mk indices usual
            MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.eval restrictedSum =
              MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.eval usualSum)

            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary

The rendered figure and project TikZ show a right up-curl at the G–H boundary and a left down-curl at the H–G boundary, each formed by two mixed trivalent junctions. Both rows place the join below the intersection and B below A. The outer strand retains α, the displayed ratio scales the entire right-hand stack, and the two stacks have complex scalars 6 and 9, respectively. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

The 27 November 2026 owner clarification (translation recheck request f13b4bd8ba9fe139) requires the drawn orientations and wiring and finite complex linear labels at marked vertices. These curls have no marked vertices. Each overlined 1 gives the centralizer coset of the loop inclusion into H.

The supplied defect-report URL returned HTTP 404 with and without a trailing slash. No correction or portal endpoint for this example was available in the task context. https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects

let U := ↥(Subgroup.closure {g : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap g})
let blockPerm : Finset Nat → Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) := fun X =>
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : Nat => x ∈ X))
let parabolic : Subgroup U → Prop := fun S =>
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (blocks i)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
    Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype _) S = iSup (fun i => blockPerm (blocks i))
let mackey := fun {V : Type} [Group V] (K : Subgroup V) (s : V) =>
  K ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj s)) K
let inclusion := fun {V : Type} [Group V] (S T : Subgroup V) (h : S ≤ T) =>
  show MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S T from
    ⟨Subgroup.inclusion h, ⟨1, fun x => by
      change (x : V) = 1 * (x : V) * (1 : V)⁻¹
      simp⟩⟩
let left := fun {V : Type} [Group V] (K : Subgroup V) (s : V)
    (S : Subgroup V) (h : S ≤ mackey K s) =>
  inclusion S K (le_trans h inf_le_left)
let right := fun {V : Type} [Group V] (K : Subgroup V) (s : V)
    (S : Subgroup V) (h : S ≤ mackey K s) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := S) (G := K) s⁻¹ (by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨k, hk, heq⟩ := (h x.property).2
    change s * k * s⁻¹ = (x : V) at heq
    rw [← heq]
    change k ∈ K at hk
    convert hk using 1
    group)
let common := fun (K G : Subgroup U) (t : U) =>
  (mackey K 1 ⊓ mackey K t) ⊓ (G ⊓ Subgroup.centralizer ({(1 : U) * t⁻¹} : Set U))
let admissible := fun (K : Subgroup U) (t : U) (S : Subgroup U) =>
  parabolic S ∧
    ∃ (h₁ : S ≤ mackey K 1) (h₂ : S ≤ mackey K t),
      left K 1 S h₁ = left K t S h₂ ∧ right K 1 S h₁ = right K t S h₂
let diagramIdentity := fun {V : Type} [Group V] (K G : Subgroup V)
    (hKG : K ≤ G) (s₁ s₂ : G) (L : Subgroup V) (c₁ : Complex)
    (c₂ : Option Complex) =>
  let a := inclusion K G hKG
  let down := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a
  let up := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a
  let M := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor down up
  let l := fun (s : G) (h : L ≤ mackey K (s : V)) => left K (s : V) L h
  let r := fun (s : G) (h : L ≤ mackey K (s : V)) => right K (s : V) L h
  let dot := fun (s : G) (h : L ≤ mackey K (s : V)) =>
    show MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a (l s h))
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a (r s h)) from
      ⟨s, by
        intro x
        apply Subtype.ext
        change (x : V) * (s : V) =
          (s : V) * ((s : V)⁻¹ * (x : V) * ((s : V)⁻¹)⁻¹)
        group⟩
  let finiteFibers := fun (s : G) (h : L ≤ mackey K (s : V)) =>
    ∀ z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier,
      Set.Finite {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis
        a a (l s h) (r s h) (dot s h) w = z}
  let outer := fun (s : G) (h : L ≤ mackey K (s : V)) (hf : finiteFibers s h) =>
    show MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M M from
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection a a (l s h) (r s h)
          [(1, ⟨dot s h, hf⟩)])
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication a a (l s h) (r s h)
          [(1, dot s h)])
  let straight : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M M :=
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id down))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id up))
  ∃ (h₁ : L ≤ mackey K (s₁ : V)) (h₂ : L ≤ mackey K (s₂ : V))
      (hf₁ : finiteFibers s₁ h₁) (hf₂ : finiteFibers s₂ h₂),
    let first := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale c₁ (outer s₁ h₁ hf₁)
    let second := outer s₂ h₂ hf₂
    let weightedSecond := Option.elim c₂ second
      (fun c => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale c second)
    straight.interpret.eval =
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.add first weightedSecond).interpret.eval
let swap := fun (i j : Nat) =>
  show U from ⟨Equiv.swap i j, by
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      rw [Equiv.swap_self]
      exact Subgroup.one_mem _
    · exact Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩⟩
let blockSym := fun X : Finset Nat =>
  Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype (Subgroup.closure
    {g : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap g})) (blockPerm X)
let S₃ := blockSym (Finset.Icc 1 3)
let S₅ := blockSym (Finset.Icc 4 8)
let G := S₃ ⊔ S₅
let K := Subgroup.zpowers (swap 1 2) ⊔ S₅
let cycle := swap 4 5 * swap 5 6
let τ := swap 1 3
let σ := τ * cycle
let L := Subgroup.zpowers (swap 7 8)
∃ (hKG : K ≤ G) (hσ : σ ∈ G) (hτ : τ ∈ G),
  let A := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (inclusion K G hKG))
  let e : G := 1
  let s : G := ⟨σ, hσ⟩
  let t : G := ⟨τ, hτ⟩
  let q := DoubleCoset.mk A A
  q e ≠ q s ∧ q t = q s ∧ (∀ j : DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (A : Set G),
    j = q e ∨ j = q s) ∧
  mackey K 1 ⊓ mackey K σ = S₅ ∧
  common K G σ = Subgroup.zpowers cycle ⊔ L ∧
  IsGreatest {S : Subgroup U | admissible K σ S} L ∧
  IsGreatest {S : Subgroup U | admissible K τ S} S₅ ∧
  Subgroup.relIndex L (mackey K 1) = 120 ∧
  Subgroup.relIndex L (mackey K σ) = 60 ∧
  Subgroup.relIndex S₅ (mackey K 1) = 2 ∧
  Subgroup.relIndex S₅ (mackey K τ) = 1 ∧
  diagramIdentity K G hKG e s L (1 / 120) (Option.some (1 / 60)) ∧
  diagramIdentity K G hKG e t S₅ (1 / 2) Option.none

let P := Equiv.Perm Nat
let Finitary := Subgroup.closure {s : P | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap s}
let blockSym := fun (D : Finset Nat) =>
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ D))
let blockProduct := fun {m : Nat} (D : Fin m → Finset Nat) =>
  iSup (fun i => blockSym (D i))
let Parabolic := fun (S : Subgroup P) =>
  ∃ (m : Nat) (D : Fin m → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (D i)) ∧ Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j)) ∧
    S = blockProduct D
let conjugate := fun (s : P) (S : Subgroup P) =>
  Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj s)) S
let embed := fun {S T : Subgroup P} (s : P) (h : conjugate s S ≤ T) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := S) (G := T) s
    (fun x => h ⟨(x : P), x.property, rfl⟩)
let inverseEmbed := fun {S T : Subgroup P} (s : P) (h : T ≤ conjugate s S) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := T) (G := S) s⁻¹ (by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨y, hy, he⟩ := h x.property
    change s * y * s⁻¹ = (x : P) at he
    rw [← he]
    have cancel : s⁻¹ * (s * y * s⁻¹) * (s⁻¹)⁻¹ = y := by group
    rw [cancel]
    exact hy)
let Span := fun (K H : Subgroup P) =>
  Σ L : {S : Subgroup P // Parabolic S},
    {α : ↥Finitary // conjugate (α : P) L.val ≤ K} ×
    {β : ↥Finitary // conjugate (β : P) L.val ≤ H}
let pairWord := fun {K H L : Subgroup P}
    (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down b)
let spanBasis := fun {K H : Subgroup P} (S : Span K H) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis
    (pairWord (embed (S.2.1.val : P) S.2.1.property) (embed (S.2.2.val : P) S.2.2.property))
let inside := fun (H A : Subgroup P) => Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype H) A
let Cosets := fun (H A B : Subgroup P) =>
  DoubleCoset.Quotient (inside H A : Set H) (inside H B : Set H)
let classOf := fun (H A B : Subgroup P) (r : H) => DoubleCoset.mk (inside H A) (inside H B) r
let OrderedSection := fun (H A B : Subgroup P) (r : Cosets H A B → H) =>
  ∃ (X : Finset Nat) (m p q : Nat)
    (D : Fin m → Finset Nat) (U : Fin p → Finset Nat) (V : Fin q → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (D i)) ∧
    (∀ a, Finset.Nonempty (U a)) ∧
    (∀ b, Finset.Nonempty (V b)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun a a' => Disjoint (U a) (U a')) ∧
    Pairwise (fun b b' => Disjoint (V b) (V b')) ∧
    (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, n ∈ D i) ∧
    (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ a, n ∈ U a) ∧
    (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ b, n ∈ V b) ∧
    H = blockProduct D ∧ A = blockProduct U ∧ B = blockProduct V ∧
    (∀ a, ∃ i, U a ⊆ D i) ∧
    (∀ b, ∃ i, V b ⊆ D i) ∧
    let rows := fun i : Fin m => Finset.filter (fun a : Fin p => U a ⊆ D i) Finset.univ
    let cols := fun i : Fin m => Finset.filter (fun b : Fin q => V b ⊆ D i) Finset.univ
    let row := fun (i : Fin m) (a : Fin (Finset.card (rows i))) =>
      U (Finset.orderIsoOfFin (rows i) rfl a).val
    let col := fun (i : Fin m) (b : Fin (Finset.card (cols i))) =>
      V (Finset.orderIsoOfFin (cols i) rfl b).val
    let Mat := fun i : Fin m =>
      {R : Fin (Finset.card (rows i)) → Fin (Finset.card (cols i)) → Nat //
        (∀ a, Finset.sum Finset.univ (R a) = Finset.card (row i a)) ∧
        (∀ b, Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun a => R a b) = Finset.card (col i b))}
    let rank := fun (S : Finset Nat) (x : ↥S) =>
      ((Finset.orderIsoOfFin S rfl).symm x).val
    ∃ classify : Cosets H A B ≃ (∀ i : Fin m, Mat i),
      (∀ (s : H) (i : Fin m) a b,
        (classify (classOf H A B s) i).val a b =
          Finset.card (row i a ∩ Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding (s : P)) (col i b))) ∧
      (∀ j : Cosets H A B, classOf H A B (r j) = j) ∧
      ∀ (j : Cosets H A B) (i : Fin m) a b (x : ↥(row i a)) (y : ↥(col i b)),
        (r j : P) y.val = x.val ↔
          ∃ k : Fin ((classify j i).val a b),
            rank (row i a) x =
              Finset.sum (Finset.Iio b) (fun b' => (classify j i).val a b') + k.val ∧
            rank (col i b) y =
              Finset.sum (Finset.Iio a) (fun a' => (classify j i).val a' b) + k.val
let sumBasis := fun {K H : Subgroup P} {ι : Type} (Z : ι → MackeyDiagrams.Biset K H) =>
  ({ carrier := Sigma (fun i => (Z i).carrier)
     act := fun g z => ⟨z.1, (Z z.1).act g z.2⟩
     one_act := fun z => Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq ((Z z.1).one_act z.2))
     mul_act := fun g h z => Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq ((Z z.1).mul_act g h z.2)) } :
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset K H)
let vectors := fun {K H : Subgroup P} (X : MackeyDiagrams.Biset K H) =>
  Finsupp X.carrier Complex
let Equivariant := fun {K H : Subgroup P} {X Y : MackeyDiagrams.Biset K H}
    (e : LinearEquiv (RingHom.id Complex) (vectors X) (vectors Y)) =>
  ∀ g x, e (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.actLinear Complex X g x) =
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.actLinear Complex Y g (e x)
let Distributes := fun {K H J : Subgroup P} {ι κ : Type}
    (X : ι → MackeyDiagrams.Biset K H) (Y : κ → MackeyDiagrams.Biset H J) =>
  let source := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.tensor (sumBasis X) (sumBasis Y)
  let target := sumBasis (fun ij : ι × κ => MackeyDiagrams.Biset.tensor (X ij.1) (Y ij.2))
  ∃ e : LinearEquiv (RingHom.id Complex) (vectors source) (vectors target),
    Equivariant e ∧
    ∀ (i : ι) (j : κ) (x : (X i).carrier) (y : (Y j).carrier),
      e (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear Complex (sumBasis X) (sumBasis Y)
          (Finsupp.single ⟨i, x⟩ 1) (Finsupp.single ⟨j, y⟩ 1)) =
        Finsupp.single ⟨(i, j), MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (X i) (Y j) x y⟩ 1
let Object := {H : Subgroup P // Parabolic H}
let linearize := fun {K H : Subgroup P} (X : MackeyDiagrams.Biset K H) =>
  letI : MulAction (K × H) (ULift.{u} X.carrier) :=
    { smul := fun g x => ⟨X.act g x.down⟩
      one_smul := fun x => congrArg ULift.up (X.one_act x.down)
      mul_smul := fun g h x => congrArg ULift.up (X.mul_act g h x.down) }

let regular := fun (H : Object) => linearize (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.regular H.val)
let Admissible := fun (K H : Object) (X : Rep.{u} Complex (K.val × H.val)) =>
  ∃ (m : Nat) (S : Fin m → Span K.val H.val),

let Hom := fun {K H : Object} (X Y : Mor K H) => Rep.Hom X.val Y.val
let Iso := fun {K H : Object} (X Y : Mor K H) => CategoryTheory.Iso X.val Y.val
let idMap := fun {K H : Object} (X : Mor K H) =>

(∀ H : Object, H.val ≤ Finitary) ∧
(∀ H : Object, Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Iso (regular H)

Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Corollary 7.5 [cor:parabolic-bicategory], p. 32. The published PDF matches the project PDF. The object data are the disjoint finite block products in the group of finitely supported permutations of Nat. The two legs of each span are conjugation embeddings in that group. The shared induction–restriction word gives the balanced biset basis of each displayed complex group-algebra tensor, and its disjoint union over a finite family gives the direct sum. Product-group representations encode the two commuting actions, with inverse right action for the second factor. All bimodules isomorphic to these sums and all bimodule maps between them are included. The balanced universal property specifies composition, and the regular bimodules, canonical maps, and coherence laws specify the bicategory. Lean checked the proposition and its implication from the translated prerequisite FiniteParabolicBicategoryComposition. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

  parabolic G → parabolic K →
  (∀ i, parabolic (H i)) → (∀ i, parabolic (B i)) → (∀ i, parabolic (H' i)) →
  ∀ (α β γ δ α' β' : ι → U)

    (hα' : ∀ i (h : H' i), α' i * (h : U) * (α' i)⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ' : ∀ i (k : K), β' i * (k : U) * (β' i)⁻¹ ∈ H' i),

  ∃ (hPG : P ≤ G) (hKP : ∀ i (k : K), v i * (k : U) * (v i)⁻¹ ∈ P),
    let inclusion : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding P G :=
      ⟨Subgroup.inclusion hPG, ⟨1, fun p => by
        simp only [Subgroup.coe_inclusion, one_mul, inv_one, mul_one]⟩⟩

            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a b c d (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms x))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp c d a' b' (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms y))

              (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms newX))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelDown inclusion (throughP i) a' b'

            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical

    Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype finitary) H =
      iSup (fun i => MonoidHom.range
        (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun k : Nat => k ∈ blocks i)))

  parabolic G → parabolic A → parabolic D → parabolic F → parabolic C → parabolic E →
  ∀ (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G A) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D A)

  let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
  let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
  let vertical := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical U _ Complex _
  let horizontal := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal U _ Complex _
  let ordinary := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary U _ Complex _

    ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id w)

routes.approach: Dispatch this dependency-ready proof. The exact reviewed type elaborated in the shared slot with import Proofs.EilenbergWatts and open scoped ModuleCat.Algebra. Use Classical.choose_spec for the precise EilenbergWatts witness named by the statement and unpack its pure-tensor universality and map law. For the forward implication, check the scaled identity on each pure tensor using the map law, balancing, scalar agreement on B, and the left-scalar rule. Use the uniqueness clause with the common balanced function to identify the two linear maps. For the reverse implication, test a scaled identity on the lifted regular module at pure b (ULift.up 1). Centrality identifies left multiplication by algebraMap Complex R z with right multiplication on the regular module. Balancing then gives equality of the pure tensors for the two actions on b. Construct a retraction of b ↦ pure b (ULift.up 1) by extending the balanced function (b,x) ↦ b·x.down to B, using commuting actions and the order of multiplication in the opposite ring. Apply that retraction. Split these checks into a scalar identity lemma, a regular retraction lemma, and a full-subcategory lemma. Lift EqualScalars.ι ⋙ ew.functor with the forward implication. For essential surjectivity, take ew.inverse of a complex-linear object and use the underlying natural iso from ew.counitIso, in the direction giving Complex-linearity of its image. The reverse implication puts the chosen preimage in EqualScalars. Lift the counit to the full subcategory and use asEquivalence on the lifted forward functor. The final field is equality of the composed functors. Prove it from the defined lift, checking objects and maps if reduction does not suffice.

routes.approach: The selected arbitrary-ring Morita endpoint requires a choice-free proof of the exact FreeAddGroup/AddCon quotient. Construct one data-valued balanced lift by FreeAddGroup.lift, testing the four relations via AddCon.addConGen_le before descending with AddCon.lift. Use quotient induction and equality on generators for extensionality. Lift action on the first factor for left scalars and the second for right scalars (as an opposite-ring action); prove each law on pure pairs. Use FreeAddGroup.induction_on for finite sums, with an empty list at zero, append for addition, and a pure pair with negated first component for the negative generator. Define tensorMap by lifting its formula on pure pairs. Construct each associator direction by successive lifts of the pure triple formula, checking each middle balance before lifting through it. Compare both composites and exterior actions on pure triples and package the specified subtype of AddEquiv with the two explicit maps. Unit maps use multiplication or the right action, and inverses insert 1. Use nested pure extensionality for naturality, pentagon and triangle at fixed symbolic objects. Audit the actual new local data declarations and final proof. This route has no dependency on the Watts inverse or parabolic composition.
